summary: AIOS Tech Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a share subscription agreement with Swift Prime Limited, wholly owned by director and Co-CEO Guo Li. The subscriber will purchase 5,000,000 Class B common shares at par value of $0.0001/share, totaling $500, with a five-year voluntary transfer restriction. Upon closing, the subscriber will hold ~60.6% of outstanding shares and ~99.4% voting power. The audit committee and board approved the related-party transaction, with recusals. This is a private placement to an insider, not a public tender or going-private transaction, and does not fit any special-situation category.
